layout.house_prompt: A medical clinic with a reception, a waiting room, four exam rooms, a lab, a pharmacy, a corridor, and two bathrooms. The reception has a reception desk with a computer. The waiting room has six chairs and a water dispenser. The first exam room has an exam table and a cabinet. The second exam room has an exam table and a scale. The third exam room has an exam table and a desk with a chair. The fourth exam room has an exam table and a stool. The lab has a lab bench and a microscope. The pharmacy has shelves with bottles. The corridor has a bench. The first bathroom has a toilet and a sink. The second bathroom has a toilet and a sink.

reception.text_description: A modern, clean-lined medical clinic reception area with a reception desk with a computer, bright neutral colors, and durable commercial finishes.

waiting_room.text_description: A modern minimalist clinic waiting room with six chairs and a water dispenser, calm neutral palette, and durable easy-clean finishes.

corridor.text_description: A modern clinic corridor with a bench, bright lighting, and clean, durable finishes.

exam_room_1.text_description: A modern clinical exam room with an exam table and a cabinet, clean neutral walls, and easy-clean flooring.

exam_room_2.text_description: A modern clinical exam room with an exam table and a scale, clean neutral walls, and easy-clean flooring.

exam_room_3.text_description: A modern clinical exam room with an exam table and a desk with a chair, clean neutral walls, and easy-clean flooring.

exam_room_4.text_description: A modern clinical exam room with an exam table and a stool, clean neutral walls, and easy-clean flooring.

lab.text_description: A modern clinic lab with a lab bench and a microscope, clean bright lighting, and seamless easy-clean finishes.

pharmacy.text_description: A modern clinic pharmacy room with shelves with bottles, secure organized storage, and durable easy-clean finishes; public service is controlled (no direct open access from waiting room).

bathroom_1.text_description: A modern clinic bathroom with a toilet and a sink, simple neutral finishes, and easy-clean tile surfaces.

bathroom_2.text_description: A modern clinic bathroom with a toilet and a sink, simple neutral finishes, and easy-clean tile surfaces.
